details.caption:
🦃 Comment “recipe” and I’ll send it! Canadian thanksgiving is NEXT Monday so you need to make my Juiciest FOOLPROOF Turkey ever. My recipe also happens to be the top searched and loved recipe on Google year after year so I know you’ll love it. 
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
https://themodernnonna.com/easy-thanksgiving-turkey/

segments.text: stop making these mistakes and make turkey like a chef there's a secret to making
the juiciest turkey to soften butter add the seasonings give it a good mix make
sure the turkey has thawed you pat it dry and you take out the giblets
massage it with the butter really well i like to get under the skin and
in the crevice in the crevice we also add an orange and tie the legs
for the secret we use julia child's method we melt butter with a little bit
of beer soak a cheesecloth and put it on top of the turkey to the
tray i'm adding some more water and beer and cooking it in the oven making
sure to baste. An hour before the turkey is done remove the cheesecloth and continue
to cook it until golden. Let it rest and follow for more.
